cavity_provenance_check.method: Read archived NPZ arrays, match each old train/query input exactly to new training inputs, compare full field rows byte-for-byte at all four levels. No simulator called.
cavity_provenance_check.conclusion: The current 40/10 Cavity I is exactly the reused first-50 field shard subset of Cavity II at every fidelity. V2 metadata and Sept6 audit call these first-50 shards converged. Describing the archived Cavity I fields as underconverged v1 is unsupported and contradicted by available provenance. Preserve predeclared sensitivity subset but describe its cavity exclusion as historical audit selection and cross-version duplication/small-size sensitivity, not confirmed present underconvergence.
